ex1En: The computer crashed, and all our records were erased.
ex1Zh: 電腦當機了，我們所有的紀錄都被消除。
ex2En: It is impossible to erase those memories from my mind.
ex2Zh: 要在我的腦海中消除那些回憶是不可能的。
ex3En: You can use an eraser to erase the pencil marks.
ex3Zh: 你可以用橡皮擦把鉛筆痕跡擦掉。

meaning: 昂貴的、豪華的；花俏精緻的；幻想；喜歡；幻想
ex1En: I had dinner at a fancy restaurant.
ex1Zh: 在一本豪華的餐廳享用晚餐。
ex2En: He bought a fancy sports car.
ex2Zh: 他買了一輛很炫的跑車。
ex3En: The boy often fancies himself as a superhero.
ex3Zh: 這個男孩時常幻想自己是超級英雄。

ex1En: It's easy to spot flocks of geese as they migrate.
ex1Zh: 當成群的野雁遷徙時，很容易發現牠們的蹤跡。
ex2En: Thirty million tourists flock to New York every year.
ex2Zh: 每年都有三千萬遊客湧入紐約。
ex3En: Birds of a feather flock together.
ex3Zh: 物以類聚 (同一種羽毛的鳥會聚集在一起)。

ex1En: I usually do grocery shopping on weekends.
ex1Zh: 我通常在週末採買生活用品。
ex2En: John bought some eggs at the grocer's.
ex2Zh: 約翰在雜貨店買了一些蛋。
ex3En: There is a grocery store around the corner from the hostel.
ex3Zh: 青年旅社的附近有一家雜貨店。

meaning: 新聞標題；以~為標題；段落標題
ex1En: I just read through the headlines of the paper.
ex1Zh: 我只瀏覽報紙的標題。
ex2En: The article is headlined "Listen to your heart."
ex2Zh: 這篇文章的標題是「傾聽內在的聲音」。
ex3En: The heading of each chapter in this book has been carefully written.
ex3Zh: 書中每章的標題都是審慎撰寫的。

ex1En: Be sure to wear a safety helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
ex1Zh: 騎乘機車一定要戴安全帽。
ex2En: The construction worker wore a hard helmet.
ex2Zh: 建築工人戴著堅固的安全帽。
ex3En: Soldiers wear helmets to protect their heads in battle.
ex3Zh: 士兵在戰鬥中戴頭盔以保護頭部。

ex1En: As I read my mother's letter, I felt more and more homesick.
ex1Zh: 當我讀母親的信時，想家的心情愈來愈強烈。
ex2En: His hometown is a small town in the middle of France.
ex2Zh: 他的家鄉是法國中部的一座小鎮。
ex3En: He felt homesick during his first week at college.
ex3Zh: 他在上大學的第一個星期感到很想家。

meaning: 戶外的；在戶外；室內的；在室內
ex1En: He likes outdoor activities.
ex1Zh: 他喜歡戶外活動。
ex2En: Most children like to play outdoors rather than stay indoors.
ex2Zh: 大部分的小孩喜歡在戶外玩耍勝過待在室內。
ex3En: The indoor flower market is a big tourist attraction.
ex3Zh: 這個室內花卉市場是一個很大的觀光景點。

ex1En: He has always been very jealous of his brother's good looks.
ex1Zh: 他一直都非常忌妒哥哥俊俏的外表。
ex2En: She felt jealous when she saw her boyfriend talking to another girl.
ex2Zh: 當她看到男友與另一個女孩聊天時，她感到忌妒。
ex3En: His success made his colleagues jealous.
ex3Zh: 他的成功讓他的同事感到忌妒。

ex1En: I've made a strawberry jelly for the children.
ex1Zh: 我做了草莓果凍給小朋友。
ex2En: Americans love peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
ex2Zh: 美國人愛吃花生果醬三明治。
ex3En: The jelly is set and ready to eat.
ex3Zh: 果凍已經凝固可以吃了。

ex1En: She loved dressing up and wearing priceless jewels.
ex1Zh: 她愛盛裝打扮並穿戴一些價值不斐的珠寶首飾。
ex2En: The burglar stole all the jewelry.
ex2Zh: 竊賊偷走所有珠寶。
ex3En: Diamonds are the most precious of all jewels.
ex3Zh: 鑽石是所有寶石中最珍貴的。

meaning: 垃圾、沒用東西；垃圾食品；破壞
ex1En: The garage is full of junk.
ex1Zh: 車庫裡頭塞滿了廢物。
ex2En: Eating too much junk food is not good for your health.
ex2Zh: 吃太多垃圾食物對你的健康有害。
ex3En: Many shops were trashed during the riot.
ex3Zh: 許多商店在暴動中被砸爛。

ex1En: He died of lung cancer.
ex1Zh: 他死於肺癌。
ex2En: Drinking too much alcohol does harm to your liver.
ex2Zh: 酒喝多了對肝臟不好。
ex3En: The patient badly needs a kidney transplant.
ex3Zh: 這位病人急需腎臟移植。

ex1En: The desk is one meter long, half a meter wide.
ex1Zh: 這桌子長一公尺寬半公尺。
ex2En: I am 172 centimeters tall.
ex2Zh: 我的身高有一百七十二公分。
ex3En: They are now a kilometer from the castle.
ex3Zh: 他們現在離城堡有一公里遠。

ex1En: Are you good at tying knots?
ex1Zh: 你擅長綁繩結嗎？
ex2En: Do you know how to knot a bow tie?
ex2Zh: 你知道如何打蝴蝶結嗎？
ex3En: He tied a tight knot in the rope.
ex3Zh: 他在繩子上打了個緊緊的結。

meaning: 隨手丟棄垃圾；亂丟垃圾
ex1En: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
ex1Zh: 在某些城市亂丟垃圾的人會被罰款。
ex2En: The sign says, "Please Don't litter."
ex2Zh: 告示上寫著「請勿亂丟垃圾」。
ex3En: The park is littered with rubbish.
ex3Zh: 公園裡滿地垃圾。

ex1En: Let's meet at the mall.
ex1Zh: 我們在購物中心碰面吧！
ex2En: The new mall has over two hundred shops.
ex2Zh: 新購物中心有超過兩百家商店。
ex3En: She spent the whole afternoon shopping at the mall.
ex3Zh: 她整個下午都在購物中心逛街。

meaning: 令人驚嘆的、不可思議的
ex1En: The Great Wall is a marvelous architectural feat.
ex1Zh: 萬里長城是個令人驚嘆的建築。
ex2En: We had a marvelous time at the party.
ex2Zh: 我們在派對上玩得很痛快。
ex3En: The weather today is just marvelous.
ex3Zh: 今天的天氣真是太棒了。

ex1En: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
ex1Zh: 她在上屆奧運贏得一面金牌。
ex2En: The silver medal and the bronze medal go to Jane and Jack respectively.
ex2Zh: 銀牌與銅牌得主分別為珍與傑克。
ex3En: He proudly displayed his military medals.
ex3Zh: 他驕傲地展示他的軍事勳章。

ex1En: I wish you a merry Christmas.
ex1Zh: 祝你耶誕快樂。
ex2En: We went for a ride on the merry-go-round.
ex2Zh: 我們去坐旋轉木馬。
ex3En: The sound of merry laughter filled the room.
ex3Zh: 歡樂的笑聲充滿了整個房間。

ex1En: She spoke confidently into the microphone.
ex1Zh: 她自信地對著麥克風說話。
ex2En: The singer adjusted the microphone stand.
ex2Zh: 歌手調整了麥克風架。
ex3En: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear you.
ex3Zh: 請對著麥克風說話，這樣大家才能聽見。

ex1En: I always heat up my lunch in the microwave oven.
ex1Zh: 我都用微波爐加熱便當。
ex2En: Some foods taste terrible after they are microwaved.
ex2Zh: 有些食物微波之後很難吃。
ex3En: Microwave cooking is fast and convenient.
ex3Zh: 微波爐烹調快速又便利。

ex1En: I often take a nap after lunch.
ex1Zh: 我常在午餐後小睡片刻。
ex2En: Children under two nap both in the morning and in the afternoon.
ex2Zh: 兩歲以下的小孩早上和下午都會小睡一下。
ex3En: The old man is napping in his armchair.
ex3Zh: 老人正在他的扶手椅上打盹。

ex1En: The wind was so cold that he turned his coat collar up.
ex1Zh: 風太冷了，所以他把外套的領子立起來。
ex2En: Our general manager always wears a necktie at work.
ex2Zh: 我們總經理總是打著領帶上班。
ex3En: Government statistics show that hourly earnings of white-collar workers are about 30% higher than those of blue-collar workers.
ex3Zh: 政府統計資料顯示，白領階級的時薪比藍領階級高三成。

ex1En: I am so happy to see my old pal Martin.
ex1Zh: 我高興要與老友馬丁碰面了。
ex2En: Hi, pal, please keep your voice down.
ex2Zh: 嗨，兄弟，說話請小聲點。
ex3En: They have been best pals since childhood.
ex3Zh: 他們從小就是最好的朋友。

ex1En: Would you like your pancake with syrup or cream?
ex1Zh: 你的鬆餅要配糖漿還是奶油？
ex2En: Most Americans like to eat doughnuts.
ex2Zh: 大部分的美國人喜歡吃甜甜圈。
ex3En: She made a stack of pancakes for breakfast.
ex3Zh: 她做了疊鬆餅當早餐。

ex1En: The parcel was wrapped in plain brown paper.
ex1Zh: 那個包裹用普通的牛皮紙包著。
ex2En: She parceled the letters and put them in the drawer.
ex2Zh: 她將信件紮好並放進抽屜。
ex3En: He parceled some food for the picnic in the afternoon.
ex3Zh: 他為了下午的野餐包了一些食物。

ex1En: He was a German, traveling on a Swiss passport.
ex1Zh: 他是德國人，持瑞士護照旅行。
ex2En: You must show your passport at the border crossing.
ex2Zh: 你必須在過境時出示護照。
ex3En: She applied for a new passport last week.
ex3Zh: 她上週申請了新護照。

meaning: 同情；遺憾的事；自憐；可憐的
ex1En: I pity her for having to work while we are on vacation.
ex1Zh: 我同情她在我們度假的時候必須工作。
ex2En: It's a pity that I cannot attend this conference.
ex2Zh: 很遺憾，我不能參加這場學術研討會。
ex3En: Stop indulging in self-pity for yourself.
ex3Zh: 別沉浸在自艾自憐中了。

ex1En: His mind is polluted by hatred.
ex1Zh: 仇恨汙染了他的心智。
ex2En: Air pollution is a serious problem in modern cities.
ex2Zh: 現代城市中的空氣汙染損害大。
ex3En: Exhaust fumes from vehicles are the major air pollutant.
ex3Zh: 車輛排放的廢氣是最主要的空氣汙染物。

ex1En: Rain has got in and rotted the woodwork.
ex1Zh: 雨水滲進來，腐蝕了木造的部分。
ex2En: Remove decaying vegetables to prevent rot from spreading.
ex2Zh: 移除腐爛的蔬菜，以防腐壞情況擴散。
ex3En: He is rotten to the core.
ex3Zh: 他真是壞到骨子裡了。

ex1En: The spade was covered with rust.
ex1Zh: 那鏟子上布滿鐵鏽。
ex2En: Iron rusts easily.
ex2Zh: 鐵容易生鏽。
ex3En: The old gate has rusted shut.
ex3Zh: 舊鐵門生鏽卡住關不上了。

ex1En: The corn was stored in large sacks.
ex1Zh: 玉米被存放在大袋子裡。
ex2En: He carried a heavy sack of potatoes on his back.
ex2Zh: 他背上背著一大袋沉重的馬鈴薯。
ex3En: The workers filled the sacks with sand to block the flood.
ex3Zh: 工人用沙填滿袋子來防洪。

ex1En: You need a gentle shampoo for your baby's fine hair.
ex1Zh: 你需要溫和的洗髮精來清潔寶寶柔細的頭髮。
ex2En: We should wash hands with soap before eating.
ex2Zh: 我們吃東西前應該用肥皂洗手。
ex3En: Many housewives enjoy watching soap operas.
ex3Zh: 許多家庭主婦喜歡看肥皂劇。

ex1En: The shepherd herds his sheep down the mountain.
ex1Zh: 牧羊人驅趕綿羊下山。
ex2En: A sheepdog can do twenty shepherds' job.
ex2Zh: 一隻牧羊犬可以做二十個牧羊人的工作。
ex3En: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
ex3Zh: 耶和華是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。

meaning: 滑倒；滑落；溜走；紙片；拖鞋；滑的
ex1En: The ground was so wet that I almost slipped.
ex1Zh: 地上很溼，我差一點滑倒。
ex2En: The glass slipped out of my hand and smashed on the floor.
ex2Zh: 玻璃杯從我手中滑落，碎了一地。
ex3En: Even when walking on the carpet, I still have my slippers on.
ex3Zh: 我即使走在地毯上，還是穿著拖鞋。

ex1En: He expressed his sorrow at my father's death.
ex1Zh: 他對我父親的去世表達哀悼之情。
ex2En: She hid her sorrow behind a forced smile.
ex2Zh: 她用強顏歡笑掩飾她的悲傷。
ex3En: Time heals all sorrows.
ex3Zh: 時間會撫平所有的悲傷。

ex1En: He was suspected of having been a spy during the war.
ex1Zh: 他遭懷疑曾在戰時擔任間諜。
ex2En: The woman hired a private detective to spy on her husband.
ex2Zh: 這名女子僱用一名私家偵探監視丈夫。
ex3En: I spied my sister in the crowd at the entrance.
ex3Zh: 我在入口處的人群中看到我妹妹。

ex1En: Thousands of football fans packed into the stadium to watch the game.
ex1Zh: 幾千名球迷擠進運動場來看球賽。
ex2En: We played basketball in the gymnasium.
ex2Zh: 我們在體育館打籃球。
ex3En: I work out in the gymnasium every day.
ex3Zh: 我每天都上健身房健身。

ex1En: The man fetched a stool and sat with the others.
ex1Zh: 那個人拿了一把凳子和其他人坐在一起。
ex2En: A stool test can help diagnose problems in the digestive tract.
ex2Zh: 糞便檢查有助於診斷消化道的問題。
ex3En: The piano stool is adjustable.
ex3Zh: 琴凳是可以調整高度的。
